mapper.select: select id, menu_name, menu_code, parent_id, ancestors, menu_type, menu_icon, sort, route_path, component_path, external_url, active_path, is_cache, is_hide_tab, is_hide, is_affix, is_full_screen, is_show_badge, show_text_badge, status, remark, if(parent_id = 0, '顶级', (select bdp.menu_name from bedrock_menu bdp where bdp.id = bedrock_menu.parent_id)) as parentName from bedrock_menu where id = #{id}

select id, menu_name, menu_code, parent_id, ancestors, menu_type, menu_icon, sort, route_path, component_path, external_url, active_path, is_cache, is_hide_tab, is_hide, is_iframe, is_affix, is_full_screen, is_show_badge, show_text_badge, status, update_time
, (exists(select 1 from bedrock_menu bdh where bdh.parent_id = bedrock_menu.id)) as hasChildren
from bedrock_menu where is_deleted = 0
and menu_name like concat('%',#{menu.menuName},'%')
and menu_code like concat('%',#{menu.menuCode},'%')
and parent_id = #{menu.parentId}
and route_path like concat('%',#{menu.routePath},'%')
order by sort
